title: Viking Sagas: Odin's Eye Three-Perspective and Shadow-Layer Analysis

claims.claim: Saga texts can be analysed as surviving narrative sources with explicit textual content.
Explicit, deep-structure and shadow observations can be represented as separate analytical layers.
Recurring temporal structures in saga events may be testable with time-series and spectral methods.
7.83 Hz and 8 Hz may be retained as separate configurable physical reference frequencies, not as established Viking frequencies.
A corpus-wide Viking-saga frequency result requires a declared corpus, source provenance and null-model testing.

provenance: Research-method record prepared for UPI; no unsupported historical or physical causal claim is asserted.
